title: Paloma and the Extraction
author: Rosalind Quintana
blurb: Ulyana Galloway, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
